d:
Namoh Namoh Remix – A devotional banger that blends divine energy with electrifying House beats. Performed by the iconic Daler Mehndi, with remix production by DJ Leo Sound, this Shiv Bhajan hits differently this Sawan 2026.
Let the power of Har Har Mahadev resonate through your speakers. A spiritual anthem for the modern soul, brought to you by DRecords, now streaming exclusively on Daler Mehndi’s Official YouTube Channel.
Song : Namoh Namoh Remix
Singer: Daler Mehndi
Composed By: Daler Mehndi
Lyrics: Daler Mehndi / Pt. Kiran Mishra/ Shahab Allahabadi
Remix : DJ Leo Sound
